global_regex_replace.description: Regex patterns applied to every account name. Key is the regex and value is the replacement.

substr_match_replace.description: If the account name contains the key the entire name is replaced with the value.

order.description: Ordered list of tokens to include in the generated profile name.

delimiter.description: Delimiter between tokens in the generated profile name.

prefix.description: Standard prefix added to all generated profile names for this SSO profile.

suffix.description: Standard suffix added to all generated profile names for this SSO profile.

pattern.description: Controls how profile name tokens are ordered and delimited.

accounts.description: Rules for rewriting AWS account names in generated profile names.

roles.description: Rules for rewriting AWS role names in generated profile names.

global_regex_replace.description: Regex patterns applied to every role name. Key is the regex and value is the replacement.

substr_match_replace.description: If the role name contains the key the entire name is replaced with the value.

rename.description: Profile name generation and rewriting rules for this SSO profile.

profile-name.description: Default SSO profile name used when no profile is explicitly provided to the CLI.
